_note: Update manifest for the HiTo plugin. Edit this template, never the generated version.json. Version and date are filled by the build (target SyncVersionToPackaging in HiTo.csproj); installer name and SHA-256 by Tools\Make-Release.ps1. Publish Output\version.json — it is the only copy carrying a real checksum. Placeholder names are not spelled out here on purpose: substitution would replace them inside this note too.
notes: Нормоконтроль: новое правило «Размеры с ручным значением». Показывает размеры, в которые число вписано вручную и расходится с измеренным. Это справка, а не ошибка; правило можно выключить.
Руководство пользователя: правило добавлено в таблицу правил нормоконтроля.
notesEn: Standards check: a new rule, “Dimensions with typed-in values”. It lists dimensions whose value was typed in by hand and differs from the measured one. A note, not an error; can be switched off.
User guide: the rule is added to the table of standards check rules.
